text:
Nina (Partnerships): Quick shout  HelixCare is live on Azure Marketplace and signed a 12-mo private + marketplace agreement this morning. Listing: https://azure.market/helixcare. Huge vertical win for Healthcare. :tada:
Cal (AE): PO received and invoiced. They added HIPAA audit export and a 24/7 SLA bump. Confirmed upsell amount in CRM.
Rohit (Customer Success): Onboarding kickoff complete. Verified VPC peering, key rotation, and audit forwarding to their Splunk instance. Small follow-up: they requested syslog timestamp format (RFC3339) 1; sending patch to @Maya.
Maya (Solutions): Patch posted to infra repo and deployed to staging. Config snippet for customers:
```
AUDIT_FORMAT=RFC3339
AUDIT_FORWARD=true
```
Also recommended enabling deduped-logs=true for high-volume audit streams.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace status: listing published -> public. URL: https://azure.market/helixcare (published 07:48 UTC).
Lena (Marketing): Love it. Can we get a 1-2 line customer quote and a screenshot of the admin compliance view for the spotlight? Planning a joint blog + webinar.
Cal (AE): Reached out to their Head of IT. Quote received: "Redwood's private deployment and audit tooling let us meet compliance and move faster." Sending to @Lena.
Priya (Legal): Confirmed marketplace addendum and DPA signed. No outstanding legal issues. Noting that export retention defaults to 90 days per the agreement.
Rohit (Customer Success): Uploaded onboarding runbook: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/helixcare-onboard.md. For CS demos, use demo token TTL=2h to avoid stale sessions.
Lena (Marketing): I'll draft the case study outline and the marketplace spotlight card. Can someone drop a screenshot and a short product blurb into the doc by EOD?
Maya (Solutions): Screenshot uploaded to GH doc (admin -> compliance view). Also added docs PR explaining syslog timestamp support and routing heavy exports to Dedicated pools during nightly windows.
Nina (Partnerships): Scheduling co-marketing sync with HelixCare next Tue. Creating Asana: "HelixCare Azure case study + webinar" assigned to @Lena @Rohit @Maya.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace analytics (first 6h): impressions=3.1k, installs=62, trials=8.
Cal (AE): FYI renewal language includes a 10% commit discount and annual security review clause. Logged in CRM.
Priya (Legal): Noted in contract. Closing thread  great work team! :rocket:
